item.title: Woman Congratulates Boyfriend And His Pregnant Mistress In Front Of All Coworkers
item.description: Many people would agree that learning about a partner’s cheating from someone else can hurt much more. It’s a much more enraging experience, adding insult to injury. This is what a woman experienced when she found out about her boyfriend’s infidelity through a screenshot. Worse, she also learned that her partner impregnated the other woman.

item.title: 37 Doctors Share Which Diseases Should Scare People More Than They Do
item.description: Advancements in technology and medicine have made many of us less worried about serious ailments. However, we tend to forget the potentially life-threatening consequences that these diseases bring, especially when not taken seriously. Here are examples from the people of Reddit, some of whom are medical professionals.

item.title: 63 Classified Documents That Might Make You Lose Faith In Humanity
item.description: The United States government reportedly classifies around three documents every second. But every now and again, authorities lift the lid, and dozens of secrets come tumbling out for all to see. People have taken a break from the Epstein Files to discuss the creepiest declassified docs out there, and these are the most disturbing.

item.title: 43 Marriage Proposals So Cringeworthy, Even The Ring Couldn’t Save Them
item.description: Buy a ring, pick a romantic time and place, get down on bended knee and pop the question. It’s as simple and as complicated as that. Some proposals are so good that they go viral. Others are so bad that they go viral too. From a “Will you marry me?” poster on a porta-potty, to a guy proposing in a public bathroom, here are some of the most cringeworthy...

item.title: “Do I Cry Or Laugh?”: If You Think Your Day Is Bad, These 79 People Would Like A Word (New Pics)
item.description: In life, there are things we can control and things we can’t. But the humbling part is that it only takes one moment of the second to completely undo all the effort of the first. These poor souls learned that lesson the hard way. What they went through is so absurdly unfortunate it’s hard not to feel for them—even if you can’t help but laugh a little at the chaos they endured.

item.title: 69 Times Designers Went Too Far And Made Things Impossible To Use (New Pics)
item.description: Design may be all about creativity, but, as with anything, too much of it can backfire. The subreddit r/DesignDesign shows exactly what happens when it does, collecting instances where designers try so hard that their creations become completely impractical and impossible to use. We’ve rounded up some of the worst and most hilarious offenders for you to see. Check them out for a good laugh and some truly baffling design fails.

item.title: 61 Posts From “White Collar Humor” That You Might Chuckle At From Your Cubicle
item.description: Corporate jobs are often considered cushy. There’s no physical labor involved, the office usually has a nice coffee machine, and workers can often leave whenever their tasks are finished. But these jobs can become extremely monotonous, so the best thing workers can do to keep their spirits up is maintain a great sense of humor! Here’s a list of white-collar memes that you might be tempted to send to your boss.

item.title: 81 Things That Happened At A Wedding That Screamed “They’re Not Going To Last Long”
item.description: You can see and hear some wild things at a wedding. Some of it may signal that a marriage is doomed from the start. Like the bride and groom showcasing that they know absolutely nothing about each other, that a spouse's parents don't respect their partner, or when the groom smashes a piece of cake right in the bride's face. Granted, these marriages didn't last long.

item.title: 29 Forgotten Celebrity Couples That Seem Like Unexpected Matches Now
item.description: It’s impossible to keep track of all the pieces of celebrity gossip. Relationships form, enemies emerge, and before long, much of their drama quietly fades from public attention. But every now and then, you stumble upon an old photo or headline and wonder to yourself, “Wait... These two? Really!?” So, to refresh your memory—or maybe teach you something new—we’ve put together a list of famous couples that flew under many people’s radars.

item.title: 69 Of The Coolest And Most Interesting Antiques That Folks Scored In Their Lives
item.description: Whether you stumble on it at your old family home or whether your dog digs it up from the yard, discovering an antique is always a special experience. This Reddit community is home to such relics that people find, inherit, or purchase. Some of them are so breathtakingly gorgeous that you will want your hands on them. Scroll through the list to check them out for yourself!
